Part 1 is dedication to this gem of a French steakhouse in Tooting Broadway Market! 🥩 AD

On Tuesdays, you can snag their two-for-one steak offer, making the steak and fries less than £10 per person! The steak is superb, sourced from the same top-notch suppliers as the fancy places. I also tried their classic French onion soup, which was a flavour explosion. It’s rich, savory, and loaded with caramelised onions, giving it a natural sweetness. And the cheese on top? Perfectly creamy with a slight nuttiness that just works 👌🏽 

Don’t miss their Sunday roast menu either with prices starting at just £17 per person. The meat is unbelievably tender, bathed in savoury, herb-infused juices, and paired with dreamy dauphinoise potatoes and carrots. Trust me, it's a match made in culinary heaven!

text:
Eating the original “Fast Food” of London 🇬🇧 Would you try this? 🐍🥧

In the 18th and 19th centuries, eels were so abundant in the River Thames that they became the cheapest, most accessible protein for working Londoners.

The coolest part? They were naturally shelf-stable. Eels produce their own gelatin when cooked and cooled, allowing them to be preserved in their own jelly without extra ingredients.

However, by the 20th century, pollution caused the eels to die out in the Thames, making them a luxury compared to beef. Today, there are only a handful of traditional shops left. 

I’m at Goddards at Greenwich, one of the oldest continuously operating pie and eel shops in London, which has been serving this Victorian staple since 1890.

There is so much to do and explore in the beautiful city of love, so here’s 10 things to add to your travel list next time you’re in Paris

6. A show at the Moulin Rouge 💃 – Experience the glitz and glamour of the famous cabaret show, the Moulin Rouge.

7. Eat gallettes at La Petite Bouclerie 🥐 – Enjoy the traditional Breton galettes from this popular boulangerie in the heart of Paris.

8. Explore Montmartre 🎨 – With its winding streets and stunning views of the city, Montmartre is a must-visit for art lovers and those seeking a more bohemian vibe.

9. Visit Galaries Lafayette 🛍️ – Shop till you drop at this famous department store, which boasts stunning views from its free rooftop terrace.

10. Glimpse the tower sparkling ✨ – At night, the Eiffel Tower is illuminated and truly sparkles, making it a must-see for any visitor to Paris.

text:
Come with me to the Ghibli Museum!🌱

Located at Inokashira Park in Mitaka, Tokyo, the Ghibli Museum showcases the work of Hayao Miyazaki and his Japanese animation studio Studio Ghibli!

The museum includes a replica of the Catbus from My Neighbor Totoro, a café, bookstore, rooftop garden, and a theater for exclusive short films by Studio Ghibli.

I went in November during “The Boy and the Heron Special Exhibition” and got to see various drawing of the film (and many others). This place is a must for Studio Ghibli fans!

Tickets are ¥1,000 (~$7) and go on sale at 10 a.m. (JST) on the 10th of each month for the following month. You are also not allowed to film inside the museum! All my videos are from outside while waiting in line or on the rooftop :)

5 must try tapas in Barcelona😋

1️⃣ Patatas Bravas — fried potatoes with spicy tomato sauce or aioli.
2️⃣ Pan con Tomate — traditional Catalan bread rubbed with tomato, garlic, and olive oil.
3️⃣ Croquetas — creamy fritters usually filled with jamón, cheese, or mushrooms.
4️⃣ Gambas al Ajillo — garlic shrimp sizzling in olive oil with chili.
5️⃣ Jamón Ibérico — thin slices of cured ham, a true Spanish delicacy.
